field.name: Product Highlights
field.value: Wide toe-box slip-on walking shoes with a mesh upper and raised knit-textured vamp. The lace-free front simplifies the closure choice; a curved ribbed heel panel and MD midsole create a distinct everyday profile. Listed assortment: Black: EU 39–46; Dark Gray: EU 39–46.
Which color and EU size combinations are listed?
Does this shoe have conventional laces?
No. It has a closed slip-on front with no conventional laces. Evaluate the collar opening and heel fit when trying the sample.
How do the two colors differ?
Black has a black side sole; Dark Gray has a white side sole. Both have the curved ribbed rear panel and orange segmented outsole.
What should I check during a sample fitting?
Try the sample with the socks you intend to wear. Assess toe space, heel fit and the collar opening before setting your bulk EU size assortment.
What is the minimum order for the original style?
The original-style wholesale minimum is 2 pairs. Quantity pricing is shown on this page; custom branding and packaging are quoted separately.
How can I arrange a sample?
Request a sample quotation with your preferred color, EU size and delivery postcode. The quotation includes the sample charge, shipping cost and proposed dispatch schedule.
What should I send for a branding or packaging proposal?
Send your logo artwork, preferred placement, packaging brief and order quantity. We can review the brief for this style and provide a proposal with the applicable minimum, cost and sample process.
How can I get a delivered quotation?

Send the color-size quantities and destination postcode or port, plus any packaging request. The quotation separates product cost from freight and sets out the dispatch plan and estimated transit time for your chosen shipping method.
